subject: Mirror Shield
text: The Mirror Shield is first found in the East Wing of the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote:
Mirror Shield
First Found: Spirit Temple, East Wing

subject: Mirror Shield
text: The Mirror Shield's surface reflects beams of light to solve certain puzzles and reflects Twinrova's magic beams.

evidence.quote:
It's surface can reflect beams of
light to other areas of the room, which is required to solve certain puzzles.
The Mirror Shield can also reflect Twinrova's magic beams, which is the only
way to defeat that boss.

subject: Mirror Shield
text: The Mirror Shield cannot be stolen by Like-Likes.

evidence.quote:
The best thing about the Mirror Shield is that it
cannot be stolen by Like-Likes.

subject: Kokiri Tunic
text: The Kokiri Tunic is green, worn at the start of the game, and cannot be lost.

evidence.quote:
The standard clothing worn by Link, the Kokiri Tunic is green in color and has
no enhancements.  You begin the game wearing this tunic, and it's the only
tunic in the game which cannot be lost.

subject: Goron Tunic
text: A free Goron Tunic is given after meeting Link the Goron in Goron City.

evidence.quote:
A free Goron Tunic is given to you after you meet Link
the Goron in Goron City.

subject: Goron Shop
text: Additional Goron Tunics can be purchased from the Goron Shop for 300 rupees with the Giant's Wallet.

evidence.quote:
Additional tunics can be purchased from the Goron
Shop for 300 rupees (which means you'll need the Giant's Wallet).

subject: Goron Tunic
text: Wearing the Goron Tunic makes Link invulnerable to the heat of Death Mountain Crater and the Fire Temple, canceling the time limit.

evidence.quote:
When
worn, Link becomes invulnerable to the overwhelming heat of Death Mountain
Crater and the Fire Temple.  In essence, it cancels the time limit you have to
remain in these areas.

subject: Zora Tunic
text: King Zora gives Link a free Zora Tunic after being unfrozen from Red Ice using a bottle of Blue Fire.

evidence.quote:
A free
Zora Tunic is given to you by King Zora after unfreezing him from the Red Ice
(use a bottle of Blue Fire).

subject: Zora Shop
text: Additional Zora Tunics can be purchased from the Zora Shop for 300 rupees once the shop door is unfrozen.

evidence.quote:
Additional tunics can be purchased from the Zora
Shop for 300 rupees (which means you'll need the Giant's Wallet).  You'll have
to unfreeze the door to the Zora Shop the same way you unfroze the King Zora.

subject: Zora Tunic
text: The Zora Tunic allows the wearer to breathe underwater, canceling the time limit while wearing Iron Boots.

evidence.quote:
The Zora Tunic is made from Zora Skin, and allows the wearer to breath
underwater in the same manner that the Zora do.  In essence, it cancels the
time limit you have to remain underwater while wearing the Iron Boots.

subject: Kokiri Boots
text: Kokiri Boots are default equipment at the start of the game and cannot be stolen by Like-Likes.

evidence.quote:
The default boots that you begin the game with, the Kokiri Boots have good
traction and react the way you would expect boots to act.  They cannot be
stolen by Like-Likes.

subject: Iron Boots
text: The Iron Boots are first found in the Ice Cavern and are required in the Water Temple.

evidence.quote:
Iron Boots
First Found: Ice Cavern
Used By: Adult Link

Found in the Ice Cavern, the Iron Boots are needed in the Water Temple.

subject: Iron Boots
text: Iron Boots sink Link to the bottom of pools of water, slow him on dry ground, and make him invulnerable to strong dungeon wind gusts.

evidence.quote:
While
worn, it forces Link to the sink to the bottom of pools of water.  While on dry
ground, the Iron Boots force Link to move very slowly, but he becomes
invulnerable to strong gusts of wind from the fans in certain dungeons.

subject: Hover Boots
text: The Hover Boots are first found in the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Hover Boots
First Found: Shadow Temple

subject: Hover Boots
text: Hover Boots allow Link to run over a pit as solid ground for one second, increase wind effects, and make running on solid ground feel like ice.

evidence.quote:
The Hover Boots can be used to run over a pit as though it were solid ground
for one second...Hover Boots increase the effects of gusts of wind in the
same way that Iron Boots decrease the effect.  While wearing the Hover Boots,
running around on solid ground is like running around on ice.

subject: Fairy Slingshot Ammunition Capacity Upgrade #1
text: The first slingshot ammunition pouch is found inside the Deku Tree and holds 30 Deku Seeds.

evidence.quote:
Fairy Slingshot Ammunition Capacity Upgrade #1
First Found: Inside the Deku Tree
Used By: Young Link

Found along with the Fairy Slingshot, this ammunition pouch holds 30 Deku Seeds
(the Slingshot's preferred ammunition).

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Shooting all targets at the Hyrule Castle Market Shooting Gallery awards the first Bullet Bag upgrade, increasing Slingshot capacity by 10.

evidence.quote:
Keep playing the minigame until you successfully shoot all of the targets, and
the clerk will award you with the first Bullet Bag  upgrade, which increases
the ammo capacity of your Slingshot by 10.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: In the Hyrule Castle Market Shooting Gallery, rupees appear in a preset order across 6 rounds.

evidence.quote:
For this first run through the Shooting Gallery, the rupees appear in a preset
order.  The order is:

1.)  In the middle
2.)  From the left, then from the right
3.)  Jumps from the middle
4.)  From the left AND right
5.)  Two rupees coming from the right, going left
6.)  Two rupees coming from the left, going right

subject: Fairy Slingshot Ammunition Capacity Upgrade #3
text: Shooting the center of the drum hanging from a tree three times in a row in the southeast corner of Lost Woods summons a Deku Scrub who gives the final Slingshot ammo upgrade.

evidence.quote:
The last Slingshot Ammunition upgrade is found in the southeast corner of Lost
Woods.  Hanging above the valley where the Twin Skullkids dance, there is a
drum hanging from a tree.  Shoot the center of this drum three times in a row
(a large "100" appears when you hit it in the correct place), and a Deku Scrub
will appear and give you the upgrade.

subject: Fairy Bow Ammunition Capacity Upgrade #1
text: The first arrow quiver is found with the Fairy Bow in the Forest Temple and holds 30 arrows.

evidence.quote:
Fairy Bow Ammunition Capacity Upgrade #1
First Found: The Forest Temple
Used By: Adult Link

Found along with the Fairy Bow, this arrow quiver holds 30 arrows.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Hitting all targets in one go at the adult Shooting Gallery in Kakariko Village rewards the first Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote:
Keep playing the game until you nail
all of the targets in one go, and the clerk will reward you with the first
Quiver upgrade.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: At the Kakariko Shooting Gallery, if a single blue rupee comes from the left, the next target will always come from the right.

evidence.quote:
Note number 2: if a single blue rupee comes from the left, then the next one
will ALWAYS come from the right, despite the randomness of the rest of it.

subject: Horseback Archery Range
text: Scoring at least 1,500 points in the Horseback Archery Range minigame earns the second Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: Once you score 1,000 points, you'll win the Piece of Heart. Play the game again and score at least 1,500 to earn the Quiver.

subject: Bomb Bag x30
text: Stopping the rolling Goron with a bomb inside the northern tunnel on the third floor of Goron City awards the Bomb Bag x30 upgrade.

evidence.quote:
Drop down to the third
level of the city (the level directly beneath the top floor), where there is a
Biggoron rolling around the level in a giant loop.  You can stop him by placing
a bomb in his path so that it explodes just as he passes over it.  If you do
this while he is passing through the tunnel in the northern part of the third
floor, then he will give you the Bomb Bag x30 as a reward for your daring.

subject: Horseback Archery Range
text: Scoring at least 1,000 points at the Horseback Archery Range in Gerudo Fortress awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
You get twenty arrows to use, and in order to win the Piece
of Heart from this game you must score at least 1,000 points...Once you score 1,000 points, you'll win the Piece of Heart.

subject: Bomb Ammunition Capacity Upgrade #1
text: The default Bomb Bag is obtained along with the Bombs in Dodongo's Cavern and holds twenty bombs.

evidence.quote:
This is the default Bomb Bag that you get along with the Bombs in Dodongo's
Cavern.  It holds only twenty bombs, but can quickly be upgraded to the maximum
level as soon as you are finished with the dungeon.
